author: massicomar
title: Meet in the Middle
summary:
You are given an array of $n$ numbers. In how many ways can you choose a subset of the numbers with sum $x$?

Input

The first input line has two numbers $n$ and $x$: the array size and the required sum.

The second line has $n$ integers $t_1,t_2,\dots,t_n$: the numbers in the array.

Output

Print the number of ways you can create the sum $x$.
explanation: 2^40 subsets is too many, values are too large for knapsack: enumerate 2^20 sums per half and count complements.
traps: Hash maps can be slow; sort + two pointers or binary search instead.

es.explanation: 2^40 subconjuntos son demasiados, y los valores son muy grandes para una mochila: enumera las 2^20 sumas de cada mitad y cuenta los complementos.
traps: Los hash maps pueden ser lentos; mejor ordenar + dos punteros o búsqueda binaria.
